aliases: ASECAM 8MP 4K IP PTZ POE 30X Zoom Speed Dome
features: 8MP 4K PoE PTZ speed dome, 360 degree endless pan / 90 degree tilt, 30X optical motorized zoom + varifocal
IR + laser night vision to ~150 m, ICR, auto-iris, PWM IR dimming
H.265 / MJPEG dual compression, triple stream, up to 30 fps, latency <200 ms
ONVIF 2.4 / RTSP, P2P XMEye cloud; works with Hikvision/Dahua/Xiongmai/Milestone platforms
6KV lightning surge protection, microSD storage, IP66 all-weather housing
3rd-party ONVIF support: Blue Iris, iSpy, Sighthound, SecuritySpy, Synology, QNAP

frigate.notes: ASECAM on the Xiongmai/XMEye OEM platform; RTSP path is firmware-dependent and UNVERIFIED. Legacy Xiongmai form shown; newer firmware may use /live/main and /live/sub. Confirm via ONVIF discovery.

home_assistant.notes: Use the ONVIF integration (Xiongmai/XMEye OEM, default port 80). XMEye cloud is proprietary; ONVIF/RTSP is the local path.

release_notes: ASECAM (Xiongmai/XMEye OEM) 8MP 4K 30X PTZ speed dome. The product title/name states 8MP 4K; some copy on the same page also cites 5.0 MP (typical ASECAM listing inconsistency). Recorded at the titled 8MP; sensor model and exact varifocal focal range are not published.
